import yaml, pathlib, sys
root = pathlib.Path("/home/siegfriedneto/projects/eternal/specification")
C = "knowledge-base"
def D(s): return f"domain/{C}/{s}"
def R(s): return f"rules/{C}/{s}"

def write(rel, fm, sections):
    p = root / (rel + ".md"); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    body = "---\n" + yaml.safe_dump(fm, sort_keys=False, allow_unicode=True, width=1000) + "---\n"
    for h, lines in sections:
        body += f"\n## {h}\n\n" + "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
    p.write_text(body)

def A(name, type_, required=None, many=None):
    a = {"name": name, "type": type_}
    if required: a["required"] = True
    if many: a["many"] = True
    return a
def REL(target, type_, card, role=None):
    r = {"target": target, "type": type_, "cardinality": card}
    if role: r["role"] = role
    return r

def elem(slug, fm, desc, resp):
    write(f"domain/{C}/{slug}", fm, [("Description", desc), ("Responsibility", resp)])

write(f"domain/{C}/_context", {"strategic": "core"}, [
    ("Description", ["The knowledge base holds what the owner supplied, the knowledge a language model extracted from it, and the graph of entities and relations built from that extraction.",
                     "The owner reads it back by searching it, by asking where an assertion came from, and by listing accepted fragments."]),
    ("Responsibility", ["It lets the owner find what the system knows and trace every answer back to the source it came from."])])

elem("raw-information", {"type": "aggregate-root", "attributes": [
        A("source_type", "source-type", True), A("received_at", "datetime", True), A("title", "string"),
        A("metadata", "string"), A("original_input", "string")],
     "relationships": [REL("raw-chunk", "composition", "1..*")]},
     ["A piece of unstructured information the owner supplied, preserved as it was received."],
     ["It is the source every extracted piece of knowledge traces back to."])
elem("raw-chunk", {"type": "entity", "aggregate": "raw-information", "attributes": [
        A("chunk_index", "integer", True), A("start_offset", "integer"), A("end_offset", "integer"),
        A("excerpt", "string"), A("locator", "string"), A("superseded_at", "datetime")]},
     ["One contiguous slice of a raw information's content, at a known position in it.",
      "A chunk with a supersession time has been superseded and is no longer current."],
     ["It anchors an information fragment to the exact place in the source it was read from."])
elem("source-type", {"type": "enumeration", "values": ["pdf", "email", "meeting-minutes", "chat", "article", "transcript", "other"]},
     ["The kind of source a raw information was received as.",
      "The material's own words for four of the values are `ata` (meeting-minutes), `artigo` (article), `transcricao` (transcript) and `outro` (other)."],
     ["It tells the owner what kind of source a piece of knowledge came from."])
elem("compliance-deletion", {"type": "aggregate-root", "attributes": [A("executed_at", "datetime", True)],
     "relationships": [REL("raw-information", "reference", "1")]},
     ["The record that a raw information was deleted to honour a data-protection obligation, and when the deletion was executed."],
     ["It keeps a deleted source's knowledge from being presented as still traceable."])
elem("information-fragment", {"type": "aggregate-root", "attributes": [
        A("text", "string", True), A("confidence", "decimal", True), A("status", "fragment-status", True),
        A("created_at", "datetime", True), A("llm_run", "string")],
     "relationships": [REL("raw-chunk", "association", "1..*", "source")]},
     ["A piece of knowledge a language model proposed from the chunks of a raw information, with the confidence it gave it."],
     ["It is the link between what a source says and the assertions the graph holds."])
elem("fragment-status", {"type": "enumeration", "values": ["proposed", "accepted", "rejected", "superseded", "deleted"]},
     ["The state an information fragment is in."], ["None."])
elem("knowledge-node", {"type": "aggregate-root", "attributes": [
        A("canonical_name", "string", True), A("status", "node-status", True)],
     "relationships": [REL("node-alias", "composition", "1..*")]},
     ["An entity the graph refers to, known by a canonical name and by its aliases."],
     ["It is what links and attributes are asserted about."])
elem("node-alias", {"type": "entity", "aggregate": "knowledge-node", "attributes": [A("alias", "string", True)]},
     ["One name a knowledge node is known by."], ["It lets a node be found under any name a source used for it."])
elem("node-status", {"type": "enumeration", "values": ["active", "needs-review", "merged", "deleted"]},
     ["The state a knowledge node is in."], ["None."])
elem("knowledge-link", {"type": "aggregate-root", "attributes": [
        A("status", "assertion-status", True), A("recorded_at", "datetime"), A("provenance", "provenance", many=True)],
     "relationships": [REL("knowledge-node", "reference", "1", "source"), REL("knowledge-node", "reference", "1", "target"),
                       REL("link-type", "reference", "1")]},
     ["A relation of one link type asserted from a source knowledge node to a target knowledge node."],
     ["It is the edge the graph is traversed along."])
elem("link-type", {"type": "aggregate-root", "attributes": [A("name", "string", True)]},
     ["A named kind of relation the catalog holds."], ["It fixes which relations a link may assert."])
elem("node-attribute", {"type": "aggregate-root", "attributes": [
        A("status", "assertion-status", True), A("provenance", "provenance", many=True)],
     "relationships": [REL("knowledge-node", "reference", "1")]},
     ["A literal value asserted about a knowledge node."], ["It holds what is known about a node that is not a relation to another node."])
elem("assertion-status", {"type": "enumeration", "values": ["active", "uncertain", "disputed", "superseded", "deleted"]},
     ["The state a knowledge link or a node attribute is in."], ["None."])
elem("provenance", {"type": "value-object", "attributes": [A("recorded_at", "datetime", True)],
     "relationships": [REL("information-fragment", "reference", "1")]},
     ["The record that a link or an attribute was asserted on the strength of one information fragment, and when that was recorded."],
     ["It lets every assertion be traced back to its source."])
elem("search-query", {"type": "value-object", "attributes": [
        A("text", "string", True), A("layers", "search-layer", many=True), A("expand", "boolean"),
        A("expand_depth", "integer"), A("link_types", "string", many=True), A("as_of", "date"),
        A("in_effect_only", "boolean"), A("include_uncertain", "boolean"), A("page", "page")]},
     ["What the owner asks a search for: a text, the layers to read, how to expand through the graph, and which page of results to return.",
      "Link types are named by their catalog name."],
     ["It carries every choice the owner makes about one search."])
elem("search-layer", {"type": "enumeration", "values": ["fragment", "node", "chunk"]},
     ["The kinds of knowledge a search matches its text against."], ["None."])
elem("page", {"type": "value-object", "attributes": [A("limit", "integer"), A("offset", "integer")]},
     ["A window over an ordered result: how many items to skip and how many to return."], ["None."])
elem("search-item", {"type": "value-object", "attributes": [
        A("kind", "item-kind", True), A("layer", "search-layer"), A("score", "decimal", True), A("hop", "integer"),
        A("summary", "string"), A("flags", "assertion-flag", many=True)],
     "relationships": [REL("information-fragment", "association", "0..*", "provenance")]},
     ["One ranked answer of a search: a knowledge node, a knowledge link or an information fragment, with the fragments that support it.",
      "Each supporting fragment is shown with its text and confidence, its raw information's source type and reception time, and its chunk's excerpt."],
     ["It tells the owner what matched, how strongly, and where it came from."])
elem("item-kind", {"type": "enumeration", "values": ["node", "link", "fragment"]},
     ["What a search item stands for."], ["None."])
elem("assertion-flag", {"type": "enumeration", "values": ["uncertain", "disputed", "low-confidence"]},
     ["A warning a search item carries about how far it can be trusted."], ["It keeps uncertainty visible instead of hidden."])
elem("accepted-fragment-filter", {"type": "value-object", "attributes": [A("llm_run", "string"), A("page", "page")],
     "relationships": [REL("raw-information", "reference", "0..1")]},
     ["What the owner narrows an accepted-fragment listing to: an LLM run, a raw information, or both, and a page."], ["None."])

rules = [

 ("search-query-not-blank", "invariant", "A search query's text MUST NOT be empty once surrounding whitespace is trimmed.", ["search-query"]),
 ("search-query-must-parse", "invariant", "A search query whose lexical parse yields no search term is refused.", ["search-query"]),
 ("search-layer-outside-set-refused", "invariant", "A search query naming a layer that is not a search layer is refused.", ["search-query", "search-layer"]),

 ("fragment-layer-matches-accepted-only", "policy", "The fragment layer matches only information fragments whose status is accepted.", ["search-layer", "information-fragment"]),
 ("node-layer-matches-through-aliases", "policy", "The node layer matches a knowledge node when the query text matches any one of its aliases.", ["search-layer", "knowledge-node"]),

 ("chunk-match-never-surfaces", "invariant", "A chunk-layer match never surfaces as a search item.", ["search-item"]),
 ("node-surfaces-only-with-accepted-mention", "policy", "A matched knowledge node surfaces only when at least one accepted information fragment mentions one of its aliases.", ["knowledge-node", "information-fragment", "search-item"]),
 ("layer-weights", "invariant", "A match's strength is weighted by 1.0 on the fragment layer, 0.9 on the node layer and 0.6 on the chunk layer.", ["search-item"]),
 ("prose-matching", "policy", "Fragment text, chunk excerpts and the fragments that mention a node are matched with Portuguese stemming and without regard to accents.", ["information-fragment", "raw-information"]),
 ("alias-matching", "invariant", "Aliases are matched without language stemming and without regard to accents.", ["knowledge-node"]),
 ("search-expands-by-default", "policy", "A search expands through the knowledge graph from its matched knowledge nodes unless its query turns expansion off.", ["search-query", "knowledge-link"]),
 ("expansion-depth-bounds", "invariant", "A search query's expansion depth MUST be between 1 and 3 hops.", ["search-query"]),
 ("unknown-link-type-refused", "policy", "A search query that expands and names a link type the catalog does not hold is refused.", ["search-query", "link-type"]),
 ("expansion-restricted-to-named-link-types", "policy", "Expansion under a query that names link types follows only links of those types.", ["search-query", "knowledge-link"]),
 ("link-types-ignored-without-expansion", "invariant", "A search query that does not expand ignores the link types it names.", ["search-query"]),
 ("expansion-follows-both-directions", "invariant", "Expansion follows a knowledge link from either of its ends.", ["knowledge-link"]),
 ("expanded-link-requires-provenance", "policy", "A knowledge link expansion reaches surfaces as a search item only when it holds provenance.", ["knowledge-link", "search-item"]),
 ("expansion-decay", "policy", "A knowledge link reached at hop h scores 0.5 raised to the power h times the score of the matched knowledge node it was reached from.", ["knowledge-link", "search-item"]),
 ("temporal-filters-apply-to-expansion-only", "policy", "The as-of date and the in-effect-only switch filter the knowledge links expansion reaches and never the fragment, node or chunk layers.", ["search-query", "knowledge-link"]),
 ("uncertain-items-excluded-on-request", "invariant", "A search query that does not include uncertain items surfaces no search item whose status is uncertain.", ["search-query", "search-item"]),
 ("item-flags", "invariant", "A search item is flagged uncertain when its status is uncertain, disputed when its status is disputed, and low-confidence when it is an accepted information fragment whose confidence is below 0.4.", ["search-item", "assertion-flag"]),
 ("search-ranking", "invariant", "Search items are ranked by score descending, then by recording time descending with a knowledge node counting as never recorded, then by identifier ascending.", ["search-item"]),
 ("search-total-before-pagination", "invariant", "A search's total counts every search item before the page is cut.", ["search-item", "page"]),
 ("link-item-summary", "policy", "A link search item's summary reads `source -[link type]-> target`, with the canonical names of its source and target knowledge nodes.", ["search-item", "knowledge-link"]),
 ("search-keeps-compliance-deleted-sources", "policy", "Search matches and surfaces information fragments whether or not their raw information was deleted for compliance.", ["information-fragment", "compliance-deletion"]),
 ("page-limit-bounds", "invariant", "A page's limit MUST be between 1 and 100.", ["page"]),
 ("page-offset-non-negative", "invariant", "A page's offset MUST be at least 0.", ["page"]),
 ("page-defaults", "invariant", "A page that omits its limit returns 20 items and one that omits its offset starts at 0.", ["page"]),
 ("provenance-requires-accepted-fragment", "invariant", "A fragment's provenance is read only when the fragment's status is accepted.", ["information-fragment"]),
 ("provenance-refused-after-compliance-deletion", "policy", "A provenance read whose chain reaches any raw information deleted for compliance is refused.", ["provenance", "compliance-deletion"]),
 ("compliance-refusal-precedes-empty-chain", "policy", "A provenance read that both reaches a compliance deletion and has an empty chain is refused for the compliance deletion.", ["provenance", "compliance-deletion"]),
 ("empty-provenance-chain-refused", "invariant", "A provenance read of an existing item whose provenance chain is empty is refused.", ["provenance"]),
 ("provenance-in-recording-order", "invariant", "A link's or an attribute's provenance lists its fragments in the order that provenance was recorded.", ["provenance"]),
 ("listing-requires-a-filter", "invariant", "An accepted-fragment listing MUST name an LLM run, a raw information, or both.", ["accepted-fragment-filter"]),
 ("listing-holds-accepted-only", "policy", "The accepted-fragment listing holds only information fragments whose status is accepted.", ["accepted-fragment-filter", "information-fragment"]),
 ("listing-excludes-compliance-deleted", "policy", "The accepted-fragment listing excludes information fragments whose raw information was deleted for compliance.", ["information-fragment", "compliance-deletion"]),
 ("listing-one-entry-per-fragment", "policy", "The accepted-fragment listing shows each information fragment once, attributed to its lowest-index raw chunk.", ["information-fragment", "raw-information"]),
 ("listing-order", "policy", "The accepted-fragment listing is ordered by source reception time descending, then fragment creation time descending, then fragment identifier ascending.", ["information-fragment", "raw-information"]),
]
descs = {
 "search-query-must-parse": ["A query made only of stop words is the typical case."],
 "chunk-match-never-surfaces": ["A chunk match only counts toward the chunks already covered by a matched information fragment."],
 "search-keeps-compliance-deleted-sources": ["The accepted-fragment listing and the provenance reads treat compliance-deleted sources differently."],
 "empty-provenance-chain-refused": ["An assertion or a fragment that exists always carries a provenance chain, so an empty one is a fault of the system rather than of the request."],
}
for slug, t, st, cons in rules:
    fm = {"type": t, "statement": st, "constrains": [D(c) for c in cons]}
    if t == "policy": fm["consistency"] = "immediate"
    write(R(slug), fm, [("Description", descs.get(slug, ["None."]))])

def refuse_rule(r, a): return {"rule": R(r), "answer": a}
prov_ok = "`{ ok: true, result }` listing the provenance fragments, each with its text, confidence and status and the raw chunks it came from, each chunk with its index, offsets, excerpt, locator and raw information (source type, reception time, metadata, original input)"
gone = refuse_rule("provenance-refused-after-compliance-deletion", "HTTP 410, error code BUSINESS_RAW_INFORMATION_DELETED, naming the earliest compliance deletion")
empty = refuse_rule("empty-provenance-chain-refused", "HTTP 500, error code SYSTEM_INTERNAL_ERROR")
write(f"contracts/{C}/retrieval", {"type": "api", "direction": "published",
  "operations": ["search", "read-link-provenance", "read-attribute-provenance", "read-fragment-provenance", "list-accepted-fragments"],
  "answers": [
    {"operation": "search", "accepted": "`{ ok: true, result }` carrying the page of ranked search items and the total before pagination",
     "refusals": [refuse_rule("search-query-must-parse", "HTTP 422, error code BUSINESS_INVALID_SEARCH_QUERY"),
                  refuse_rule("search-layer-outside-set-refused", "HTTP 422, error code BUSINESS_INVALID_SEARCH_LAYER, naming the allowed layers"),
                  refuse_rule("unknown-link-type-refused", "HTTP 422, error code BUSINESS_UNKNOWN_LINK_TYPE")]},
    {"operation": "read-link-provenance", "accepted": prov_ok,
     "refusals": [{"when": "No knowledge link is held at the requested identity.", "answer": "HTTP 404 reporting not found"}, gone, empty]},
    {"operation": "read-attribute-provenance", "accepted": prov_ok,
     "refusals": [{"when": "No node attribute is held at the requested identity.", "answer": "HTTP 404 reporting not found"}, gone, empty]},
    {"operation": "read-fragment-provenance", "accepted": prov_ok,
     "refusals": [{"when": "No information fragment is held at the requested identity.", "answer": "HTTP 404 reporting not found"},
                  refuse_rule("provenance-requires-accepted-fragment", "HTTP 404, error code BUSINESS_FRAGMENT_NOT_ACCEPTED"), gone, empty]},
    {"operation": "list-accepted-fragments", "accepted": "`{ ok: true, result }` carrying the page of accepted fragments, each with its text, confidence, LLM run, creation time and source (raw information, chunk index, source type, reception time, document title)"},
  ]}, [("Description", ["The owner's read surface over the knowledge base: search, the three provenance reads, and the accepted-fragment listing."])])

write(f"scenarios/{C}/stop-words-only-query", {"subject": R("search-query-must-parse"),
  "given": ["the owner writes a search query made only of stop words"],
  "when": ["the owner searches with it"],
  "then": ["the search is refused", "no search item is returned"]},
  [("Description", ["The query has characters, so it passes the length and blank checks, and still yields no search term."])])

for slug, st, fit in [
 ("retrieval-is-read-only", "Every retrieval operation runs inside a read-only transaction.", "each retrieval operation's database transaction is opened read-only"),
 ("retrieval-transports-answer-alike", "The REST and MCP transports answer every retrieval operation they both expose as `{ ok, result }` on success and as `{ ok: false, error: { code, message, details } }` on refusal, with the same error codes.", None),
 ("llm-toolset-omits-fragment-listing", "The language model's query tool surface exposes search and the three provenance reads and does not expose the accepted-fragment listing.", None)]:
    fm = {"statement": st, "scope": C}
    if fit: fm["fitness"] = fit
    write(f"constraints/{slug}", fm, [("Description", ["None."])])

log = {"entries": [
 {"location": f"domain/{C}/_context.md", "field": "strategic", "unstated": "The material does not say whether the knowledge base is core, supporting or generic.",

 {"location": f"domain/{C}/raw-information.md", "field": "relationships.raw-chunk.cardinality", "unstated": "The material does not say whether a raw information can hold no chunk.",
  "decided": "1..*", "why": "Every fragment is attributed to a chunk of its raw information, so a raw information without a chunk would yield nothing to read."},
 {"location": f"domain/{C}/knowledge-node.md", "field": "relationships.node-alias.cardinality", "unstated": "The material does not say whether a knowledge node can have no alias.",
  "decided": "1..*", "why": "The node layer reaches a node only through its aliases, so a node without one could never be found."},
 {"location": f"domain/{C}/raw-information.md", "field": "attributes.metadata.type", "unstated": "The material names a raw information's metadata without giving its shape.",
  "decided": "string", "why": "The retrieval only passes the metadata through to the owner and reads nothing inside it."},
 {"location": f"domain/{C}/information-fragment.md", "field": "attributes.llm_run.type", "unstated": "The material names the LLM run a fragment came from only as a filter and a listed field.",

]}

added.unstated: The material does not say whether the knowledge base is core, supporting or generic.

added.unstated: The material does not say whether a raw information can hold no chunk.
added.why: Every fragment is attributed to a chunk of its raw information, so a raw information without a chunk would yield nothing to read.

added.unstated: The material does not say whether a knowledge node can have no alias.
added.why: The node layer reaches a node only through its aliases, so a node without one could never be found.

state_meanings.unreadable: the located field could not be read at the landing commit — the log names a field the node did not hold when the entry was written
state_meanings.unlocated: no commit of the log contains this entry's text; the landing cannot be found

route_meanings.corrective: a /deliver-scope commit whose slug names a correction — corrective, hotfix, fix, abandon or revert — read as behavior contradicting the decision and a person routing the correction; the reading rests on the slug's words
route_meanings.framework: a /deliver-scope commit whose slug names no correction — the framework re-authoring the field
route_meanings.hand-edit: a commit no framework skill wrote — a person changed the artifact directly
